2026-08-05 23:23:46.508474 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-08-05 23:23:46.508495 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-08-05 23:23:46.508500 | controller |
2026-08-05 23:23:46.508505 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-08-05 23:23:46.508509 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-08-05 23:23:46.508512 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-08-05 23:23:46.508516 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-08-05 23:23:46.508519 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-08-05 23:23:46.508523 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-08-05 23:23:46.508526 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
